body: Done in 3dd015d2 (PromptCacheSim/index.tsx and styles.module.css): two terminals side by side, one per cache, a break line for each pause (orange when it outlasts that cache), and a status line with read or expired and the cost so far. Back and Next click through one turn at a time, and you can set the next pause beside Next. The old table is under "Every turn as a table". There's an after picture in the thread; on a phone the terminals stack. It's on branch chat-sim-click-through, ready to check.
